title: # Build: live key + health checks in the banners (Angel profile, Opus, one session, no sub-agents) …
asked: # Build: live key + health checks in the banners (Angel profile, Opus, one session, no sub-agents) axHub tool allowed: load CLAUDE.md, the shared + repo RULES.md and THREADS.md (claude-sync, else axhub.memory_read), then build. Branch claude/live-key-checks. Steps of 30 min or less in the **Angel** orchestrator (_claude/builds/profiles/angel/orchestrator.json; Brett: "I want it in the new build profile", not Refactor). Brett (voice, Oct 30 2026): the console's GITHUB_TOKEN went dead today (GitHub answers 401) and nothing told him. "You need to make sure things like that go into one of the banners. I need to see that kind of shit." 1. Live checks, not just "is it set": in the systems check / keys-needed banner plugins (read both first; extend whichever owns key checks, add to the other only through its check registry), every key and connection is tested against its service on a schedule (every 15 min, plus on console start and on Check now) with a cheap read-only call: GitHub token (GET /user + scopes the push banner and CI helpers need: repo, pull requests, actions, contents), axHub MCP token, Claude Code token / Anthropic key (cheapest auth check), Hostinger token, ntfy topic, OpenAI / ElevenLabs keys if agent-voice has them, the push notification path to AmberX, git push credentials on the VPS checkout. Results cached; never log or show a secret. 2. A dead, expired, missing-scope or unreachable key shows as a **red banner item** that says in plain words what broke, what it breaks (e.g. "push banner, auto-merge and branch cleanup can't reach GitHub"), since when, and an **Auto fix** or **Fix** button (open the right settings field with a test-before-save, or the exact page to make a new token, e.g. GitHub fine-grained token settings with the scopes listed). Expiring soon (GitHub token expiry header) shows amber a week ahead. Goes green by itself once it works again. 3. A registry so any plugin can add a health check (capability health@1: id, label, run(), severity, fix action), and the banner lists them all. Do NOT edit push-banner now (another build owns it, claude/pr-only-merge); add a follow-up step to move its token check onto health@1. 4. Also report: builds stuck (a build tmux session or change-log entry with no heartbeat for 30 min, or a headless launch that exited at once like today's root / go-pass failures), veto calls denied or expired, CI failing on main, a container restarting (amberx-app-backup-1 is in a restart loop right now), disk over 85%. 5. Push every new red item to AmberX through the existing push path (one push per item, not repeats). 6. Rule in _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md: anything broken that Brett needs to know about or fix goes into a banner item with a fix, never only in chat or a log. 7. Coordinate: enterprise-branding (claude/enterprise-branding-3) will restyle these banners later; keep your UI to framework controls + tokens so its restyle applies cleanly. Don't touch veto/approvals (claude/veto-complete), ui-review, plan-studio. Tests with fake services (ok, 401, missing scope, expiring, unreachable), console tsc + vite build, check-theme, check-controls, plugin-lifecycle checks, screenshots. THREADS row, Angel orchestrator, axHub change log. Push, open the PR (gh/git if the banner token 401s). Don't merge. Anything needing Brett = a veto call with a reason, never polled.

steps.text: live key probes (GitHub scopes/expiry, Claude, ntfy, git push…)
system checks (stuck builds, veto, CI main, containers, disk)
banner UI: red items, breaks/since, test-before-save
tests + tsc + vite build + theme/controls/lifecycle checks + screenshots

result.summary: Built and tested (self-test 184, tsc, vite, check-theme, check-controls, lifecycle). Committed 971ec52f on claude/live-key-checks; push/PR blocked: no GitHub push credentials on the VPS (BLOCKED entry chg-20261030-b10c4ed9f1).
